gates.requirement: Frozen scene, asset, controller, simulator, scorer, task version, visibility and motor-limit identities.
At least one continuous full native success per declared configuration, including L2 discovery or L3 recovery where claimed. Local probes do not count.
High-level plan, selected skills and constraints, key states, HL_LL / LL_TRAJ / HL_TRAJ mappings with shared-clock command and physics indices.
Continuous support and conservative full carrier/parcel envelope clearance during the complete door occupancy interval, not only center crossing.
Complete representative expert execution through validated agent action interface; hidden parameters and privileged reference files excluded.
Independent rescoring; positive, noop, support-gap, collision, incomplete-release and integrity-tampering controls.
Three preselected same-seed representative repeats with unchanged identity and tolerances; retain every failure and environment error.
Accessible expert source, plans, complete raw trajectories, physical audits and videos with verified hashes; synchronized task-page state.
Named human review of declared representative full videos and critical positive/negative clips; never inferred from automated checks.
Independent person's reproduction record on another physical machine; author-run cluster jobs may demonstrate machine portability but cannot impersonate another person.

H3-01-legacy-portability.selection: Existing no-prop-delivery-07 reference configuration, frozen published runtime, retained native online controller.
H3-01-legacy-portability.failure_rule: If the first attempt exposes a common runtime or physical failure, record it and diagnose before scheduling remaining repeats. No seed replacement.

heterogeneous.note: Freeze the repeat identity and comparable benchmark budget after pilot feasibility, before the acceptance repeats.

H3-02-legacy-portability.selection: Frozen published heavy_prop representative configuration; unchanged original 180 s task criteria.

cohorts.legacy_success_criterion: Three full physical successes under original task gates and unchanged source identity; elapsed-time spread reported separately, no claim of bitwise-identical trajectories.

role_selection: User confirmed: preserve original parcel; G1 carries, Stretch supports door or arranges tools. Full physical role transfer remains to be demonstrated.
